# Immutable catalog fixture

hello-world.yaml is copied byte-for-byte from susumutomita/TenkaCloudChallenge,
commit a749b142416770abee3f173673702c55df3856aa,
challenges/hello-world/template.yaml, under that repository's Apache-2.0 license (original text in CHALLENGE-LICENSE).
No real credentials, flag seed or participant data is included. Runtime tests
provide disposable random parameters. Keep the original template unchanged;
this fixture verifies compatibility with the actual catalog resource graph.
